changelog: **Certificates with Turkish names no longer fail (#3319):** pdf-lib's standard fonts are WinAnsi and threw on `ş ğ ı İ` ("WinAnsi cannot encode ı"), so generating a certificate or reference letter for a Turkish name answered 500. Every string `generateCertificatePdf()` draws now goes through `pdfSafeText()` (new `src/lib/pdfText.ts`, shared with the offer letter): WinAnsi characters are kept, accented letters fold to their base letter, `ı/ł/đ/ħ` are mapped by hand, anything else becomes `?`. PDF only — on-screen text is unchanged. Pinned by `e2e/certificate-pdf-turkish.unit.spec.ts` (@smoke).

en: Certificates and reference letters can now be generated for names with Turkish letters.
tr: Türkçe karakter içeren isimler için sertifika ve referans mektubu artık sorunsuz oluşturuluyor.
de: Zertifikate und Referenzschreiben lassen sich jetzt auch für Namen mit türkischen Buchstaben erstellen.
